notes: The trap is m6: after we accepted on Net 30, the supplier changes payment terms by email to Net 45. A change to payment.terms is a money detail held for verification, so Net 45 is tentative (held_for_verification) and Net 30 stays active; the agent must not agree to Net 45 in its reply. 'Everything else stands' restates nothing new. m8 does not withdraw the Net 45 statement, so it stays tentative. Distractors: $25k/yr threshold, Nov 1 effective date, cost center 3302, SKU 88-CR8-L, phone/extension, $5,490 extended, PRO#.
